# Synthetic PKCS#12 directory fixture

synthetic-directory.p12 is generated by tests/_synthetic_pkcs12.py. It contains
only three synthetic X.509 certificate objects and placeholder bags. The
shrouded key bag and the encrypted authenticated safe contain fixed marker
bytes, not private keys, and cannot be decrypted.

Fixture contents:

 - auth_safe.authenticated_safe[0].safe_contents[0]: certificate A, friendly
   name Shared Legacy, registration REG-001 certificate SHA-256 match
 - auth_safe.authenticated_safe[0].safe_contents[1]: certificate B, friendly
   name Shared Legacy, different certificate identifier
 - auth_safe.authenticated_safe[0].safe_contents[2]: certificate C, friendly
   name Visible Only, unique visible certificate for REG-002
 - auth_safe.authenticated_safe[0].safe_contents[3]: encrypted private key
   placeholder, friendly name Visible Only
 - auth_safe.authenticated_safe[1].encrypted_data: encrypted safe contents
   placeholder

Review decision: the two entries named Shared Legacy share a name but not a
certificate identifier. Only safe_contents[0] has a certificate SHA-256 that
matches REG-001, so only that entry is claimed. safe_contents[1] remains in the
name-conflict section. The Visible Only key bag is a placeholder, so it cannot
compete with the visible certificate C for REG-002.
